sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: connectedToMainPower and connectedToEmergencyPower are placed on each nonMagneticHeadingMeans as required by their authoritative requiredOwner, but their supplied canonical metadata declares benchmarkEntity as the domain, so the candidate violates the canonical domain. Reconcile the canonical metadata or replace these with canonical properties whose declared domain is nonMagneticHeadingMeans; do not relocate the checks to benchmarkEntity.
